title: CommonsCoachDashboardCard
description: One per-worker card rendered by `atdd coach dashboard` — the data the reader produces from coach runtime and the grid renderer consumes.

operations.description: Render one card per worker for a coach run

issue.description: GitHub issue number the worker is on (null if unknown).

title.description: Issue title (cached GitHub REST lookup; empty when offline/unavailable).

phase.description: Worker's current ATDD lifecycle phase. Workers exist only for agent-owned phases (INIT..REFACTOR); COMPLETE/BLOCKED/OBSOLETE have no agent and so never appear on a worker card.

surface.description: cmux surface ref (e.g. 'surface:623') — distinguishes multiple workers on the same issue; empty if unknown.

idle.description: Human time since last activity; meaningful only when stalled.

stalled.description: True when idle exceeds the 10-minute drift threshold; renders the ⚠ header flag.

progress.description: Lifecycle position for the progress bar.
